description: Read events, ticket types, orders and attendees, run the registration checkout, and check attendees in.

api.description: Check an attendee in, or revert their check-in, by ticket barcode. Passing `eventcheckin: true` twice is harmless.

fields.description: True only when `checkinstatus.status` confirms a check-in this call asked for. False when the status reports a failure, an "already" state or a revert; null when the status text does not say. A revert (`eventcheckin: false`) therefore never answers true: read `checkinstatus.status` for its outcome. Eventzilla answers HTTP 200 even for a failed check-in, so read this rather than the status code.
